desc: Ideation: model the problem as parity constraints over row/column variables and choose the parity DSU approach.
Implement fast input handling for up to 1e5 test cases and total 1e6 cells, and efficiently compute powers of 2 modulo 998244353.
For each test case, compute the parity of A-tile counts in every row and column; immediately output 0 if any row or column parity is odd.
Scan the grid while maintaining row-prefix and column-prefix XORs of A-tile constraints to determine, for each B cell, the required parity between its row-flip variable and column-flip variable.
Add each B-cell parity equation to a DSU with parity over H row variables and W column variables, detecting contradictions.
If no contradiction exists, count the connected components among all H+W variables, including isolated ones, and output 2^components modulo 998244353; otherwise output 0.
Test the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases such as all A, all B, and grids with isolated row/column variables.
